MAR.note: The document says e-services rely on the CNIE but does not say an online identity check or authentication service is run.
Nothing stated on links between civil register and ID system.

facts.fact: Morocco's education ministry says it has digitised several services for baccalaureate candidates, including checking personal data, applying for a post-bac grant, getting results, filing complaints and a digital diploma.

systems.owner: Ministry of National Education, Preschool and Sports

MAR.note: No count or share of the population holding the CNIE is given.
Nothing stated on an ID number at birth.
Nothing stated on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
The diploma record carries the CNIE number, but it is the education ministry's own diploma database, not a public register keyed on the ID as the study defines it; no register adoption is stated.

facts.fact: Morocco's education ministry says 2024 baccalaureate candidates must obtain the electronic national identity card (CNIE) and give its number, which is now recorded on the diploma.
